newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine stocks seen keeping firm tone.
newsitem.headline: Argentine stocks seen keeping firm tone.

text.p: Argentine stocks were seen little changed at the opening Tuesday and keeping their positive bias, traders said.
"The tone is firm although players are pretty choosy, looking for stocks which offer good returns and low risk," said Maximiliano Goff at traders Rio Research.
The blue-chip MerVal index rose 0.8 percent Monday to 738.28, stretching last week's 2.4 percent gains.
Traders said the bolsa was relieved by Monday's surge in the Dow and by the lack of major U.S. economic indicators this week.
"Stocks absorbed early profit-taking yesterday and switched to gains, tracking the Dow, which is a positive sign," Goff said.
However, some brokers pointed out that the bolsa's modest gains Monday were in sharp contrast to the Dow's 2.0 percent rally, and could mean the local market has run into a short-term ceiling.
"There's a sense of calm, which could help the bolsa consolidate at these prices in order to attempt an assault on its next major resistance level of 750," another trader said.
